title: Secondary Drafts
description: Followers draft a strategy card's secondary while the primary and earlier seats are still resolving, mark the draft ready, and the server submits it when the live window reaches their seat. Synthetic server messages against the real app, not captured engine states.

shots.heading: Announced while the primary resolves
shots.caption: The opponent has played Technology and is still choosing. The follower's header gains a 'Technology secondary · Draft now' tab next to Live, independent of the tactical draft button.

shots.heading: Follow or skip
shots.caption: The Secondary workspace asks the ordinary secondary question on a private copy of the game. The strip names the card, who played it, that the primary is still resolving, and the assumptions the preview makes.

shots.heading: Technology: research pick
shots.caption: After following, the draft continues into the same research picker the live game uses. Nothing has been submitted yet.

shots.heading: Complete and ready
shots.caption: The draft is complete and marked Ready: the tab and the strip both say so, and 'Not ready' withdraws it. Any new answer or a reset also withdraws readiness.

shots.heading: Window open, one seat ahead
shots.caption: Once the primary has resolved the strip counts the followers the live window asks first.

shots.heading: Submitted from the draft
shots.caption: When the window reached this seat the server answered it from the recorded choices; the ready and reset controls are gone.

shots.heading: Stops before a draw
shots.caption: Politics draws action cards. The follow is recorded and can be made ready, but the preview stops before the cards: they are only ever seen in the live game.

shots.heading: Construction: where to build
shots.caption: After following, the draft asks where the structure goes with the same on-map planet picker as the live game.

shots.heading: Warfare: home production
shots.caption: After following, the draft opens the production builder for the home system; payment and placement follow in the draft as well.

notes.title: Order
notes.text: The live window still resolves clockwise, one seat at a time. Only the deciding happens in parallel.

notes.title: Fallback
notes.text: A draft that does not match the live question, or was never marked ready, leaves the seat its ordinary live prompt.

notes.title: Nested choices
notes.text: Every card's follow-up choices are drafted too: Leadership's purchases, Diplomacy's planets, Construction's structure, Warfare's production and Technology's research. Politics and Imperial stop at their draw.
